craft_notes: Sthāyin: naming-joy (the seal + the new teaching). Sanskrit first: seal (final state declared — resolves v24's yat), pivot (rest told), condition (śakti wakes from navel) → L4 sets seal+pivot line 1, condition line 2. Rows: row 3 (now/when correlative — 'now/when' kept). Rupture: colon after 'sing' — sealing done, teaching sung. Close: end-weight on the ring ('navel's ring' — cakra as ring, singable). Minimal pass: 'I sing' for adhunocyate (now-told as sung-telling; teacher-voice kept); 'pours' for viniryātā (forth-come as pour, same motion). Read aloud: line 1 declares (told/sing stressed), colon, line 2 flows (wakes/pours/ring). Rejected: 'I teach' — killed: singing tells, teaching lectures; 'emerges' flat — killed: pour keeps nectar's logic (v29).

lines: The final state stands told. Now rest I sing:
when śakti wakes and pours from the navel's ring.
l4.sanskrit_cite: antāvasthā samākhyātā viśrāmas tv adhunocyate / nābhicakraviniryātā yadā śaktiḥ prabudhyate

reads_against.argmap: That is the final state declared; and rest is told next, when śakti wakes from the navel wheel.
c1_essence: Knots burst, touch turns divine, drops throb from the navel bulb.
